title: [LOGGED OUT] Page response has the usual security headers
reason: Only Strict-Transport-Security present; Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are missing

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store/ and wait until loaded
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss"
Read the response headers of https://site.ludus-game.com/store/
steps.saw: Response headers (same-origin fetch and curl) were only: cache-control, content-encoding, content-type, date, expires, strict-transport-security, vary, x-geoip-*, x-guploader-uploadid, x-real-ip, x-request-id, set-cookie
No content-security-policy header and no CSP meta tag

steps.text: Are "X-Frame-Options" (or a CSP frame-ancestors rule) and "X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff" present?
steps.saw: Neither x-frame-options, x-content-type-options nor CSP frame-ancestors present
